text: Grab's FY2025 20-F discusses media speculation about a draft Indonesian presidential decree that would lower the current 20% cap on driver-partner commissions (a 15% commission cap plus a 5% optional supporting-fee cap under Ministry of Transportation Decree No. 667 of 2022, as amended) to a flat 10% commission cap. The draft decree would also reclassify driver-partners as quasi-employees (requiring Grab to fund accident/death insurance and health, old-age and pension contributions) and allow government review of driver-partner agreements and unionization rights [Grab, FY2025, p.16].
